verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows consumer-facing automation mentions like 'Automate tasks with Shortcuts' (macos-docs-19) and Spotlight actions (macos-docs-15), with no documented public API, SDK, or programmatic interface for AI agents to drive macOS; explicit probes for OpenAPI/llms.txt/docs-md endpoints all returned 404 (macos-probe-1, macos-probe-2, macos-probe-3), indicating no discoverable public API surface.
